about: BN4's AquaSoul (Blue Moon's Soul 11, form 11: kind Aqua, element Aqua, his charged shot power attack 0x23 into family 0x1E, the spread shot's kind 0xD, 30 frames; his chip charge an Aqua chip held 20 frames, doubled) in BN4 Red Sun's own battle on the guest core against BN6's with AquaSoul moved (docs/multirom/bn4-souls.md): BN6's Soul 15 over the proxy form, his charged shot's power attack copied with Spreads' unit (BN6's 0xD0), his chip charge BN5's empty power of the same times (ToadSoul's 0x1B), BN4's charge test and its bonus (soulbn4.c), his face MegaMan's plain one (the owner's call).
